c.v: CPU-controlled transfer indicates the transfer, in which the data to send is from GP-SPI data buffer and the received data is stored to GP-SPI data buffer.
In such transfer, every single transaction needs to be triggered by the CPU, after its related registers are configured.
For such reason, the CPU-controlled transfer is always single transfers (consisting of only one transaction).
CPU-controlled transfer supports full-duplex communication and half-duplex communication.
